deletion_policy.description:
Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance. Defaults to "DELETE".
When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the instance,
the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.

description.rationale: It is the metadata used to describe zone and has no security impact

dns_zone_id.rationale: It acts as the key for a DNS peering configuration that tells Apigee how to resolve hostnames within a specific private DNS zone and does not necessary have security impact.

domain.rationale: The domain name for the DNS peering zone, identifying which private DNS records Apigee resolves. This is an identifier/reference to a team-owned DNS namespace; we do not constrain resource names or pointers to other resources, and there is no generic secure value to enforce.

org_id.description:
The Apigee Organization associated with the Apigee instance,
in the format 'organizations/{{org_name}}'.
org_id.rationale: It sets organization name and has no security impact

peering_config.target_network_id.description: The name of the producer VPC network.

peering_config.target_project_id.description: The ID of the project that contains the producer VPC network.
